source_kind: lawful paraphrase of a standard two-stage entry-deterrence game
source_reference: Osborne, An Introduction to Game Theory, entry-deterrence extensive-form example

interpretation.target: The unique pure subgame-perfect profile is (enter, acquiesce), while (stayOut, fight) is Nash but not subgame-perfect.

route_independence: Each route has a separate seed, solver workspace, candidate, and evaluation. Neither candidate may import the other route.
